identity.label: ACE-Step 1.5
identity.description: Open text-to-music and full-song creative-audio foundation model with lyrics, reference audio, editing, cover generation, vocal-to-BGM, metadata control, and LoRA training.
identity.parameter_count: 2B DiT turbo/SFT/base variants; 4B XL DiT variants; 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B LM sidecars
identity.model_format: Hugging Face snapshots; official Python/uv runtime; MLX backend on Apple Silicon

benchmark.output_quality_notes: Strongest next candidate for Vox Jot Studio's Music/Song lane based on upstream feature fit and permissive license. It should not be ranked until Vox Jot has a creative-audio benchmark suite for prompt adherence, song structure, loop quality, music-bed usefulness, generation latency, cancellation, export behavior, and app-path validation.

blockers: No Vox Jot Creative Audio benchmark suite exists yet
Mac latency, memory pressure, output format, cancellation, and export behavior need full-suite measurement before ranking
verdict.notes: ACE-Step is app-managed through its dedicated creative-audio runtime and model snapshot. Keep it unranked in Testing until the full Creative Audio benchmark exists. Existing dictation, transcription, readback, overlay, and paste hot paths must not load or initialize this runtime.
